Every frame in c2b-ra7a-trimmed.pcap, in capture order (indices are
positions WITHIN the trimmed file, not the pod capture's own numbering).
A cat-0x82 op-0x01 grant overwrites the name span with the resource's
value block, which is why its 'name' column reads as block bytes.
